title: Randomized Study to Evaluate the Effect of Obicetrapib in Participants With Preclinical Alzheimer's Disease
official: A Phase 2b, Randomized, Double Blind, Placebo Controlled, Parallel Group Trial to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Obicetrapib in Participants With Preclinical Alzheimer's Disease (SPINOZA Trial)
summary: A study evaluating Obicetrapib in adults potentially at risk for Preclinical Alzheimer's Disease
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* participants with preclinical AD

Exclusion Criteria:

* APOE genotype not meeting protocol-defined eligibility criteria
